parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: DetectionRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom rule. You can obtain the rule ID from the rule list.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom rule.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are deployed. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: assets in the Chinese mainland and China (Hong Kong)

- ap-southeast-1: assets outside China

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of a member. This parameter is used by an administrator to switch to the perspective of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

parameters.name: VerifyType
parameters.description:
The verification result for the accuracy of alert fields based on the alert template.

- true: The verification is passed. Alerts that are generated for enabled rules can be synchronized to the product.

- false: The verification failed. Alerts cannot be synchronized to the product.
